However, as an active OrbitPlus member, you can request a loaner laptop during the repair, subject to availability and a refundable USD 200 deposit.

answers.question: My HomeHub Mini will not control a third-party smart bulb that shows the same wireless logo. Is that a warranty defect?
answers.actual_answer: The issue with your HomeHub Mini not controlling a third-party smart bulb is not considered a warranty defect. The HomeHub Mini is designed to control only OrbitTech-certified devices, and third-party products, even if they show the same wireless logo, are not automatically certified. Compatibility is determined by the current list published in the OrbitLink application.
